usedFor: Each new Zoho CRM account gets its contact checked by ApexVerify.

bestTemplate.name: “New Account” in Zoho CRM, then “Verify Email or Phone” in ApexVerify
bestTemplate.why: Checking one contact as the account appears catches bad details before anyone writes to it.

watchOut: “Verify Email or Phone” needs a verification type and a target country chosen up front.
